report.summary: Reviewed daedalus/kairos/control.py chunk 1 of 1: thin CLI wrappers over core functions; all docstring claims kept; no hidden defects found.

handoff.purpose: CLI entry points that delegate to core functions for dashboard, models, queue, watcher, squads, quality, and review diff.

symbols.name: dashboard
symbols.note: Returns core.get_dashboard(project); no local side effects.

symbols.name: ollama_models
symbols.note: Returns core.model_resources(); no local side effects.

symbols.name: review_diff
symbols.note: Returns core.review_diff(project, lane); lane defaults to 'local_only'.

symbols.name: _print_json
symbols.note: Prints JSON with indent=2 and default=str.

symbols.name: main_dashboard
symbols.note: CLI for dashboard; --project optional; --json prints full JSON else prints selected_project.

symbols.name: main_models
symbols.note: CLI for ollama models; --json prints JSON else prints each model name and size_gb.

symbols.name: main_squads
symbols.note: CLI for squads; --project optional; --json prints JSON else prints a summary line.

symbols.name: main_watcher
symbols.note: CLI for watcher status; subcommand 'status' with --project and --json; else prints help.

symbols.name: main_review_diff
symbols.note: CLI for review diff; --project required; --lane choices; --json prints JSON else prints payload['queued'].

claims.why: The function produces a JSON payload when --json is passed.
The function calls ollama_models() and prints model resources.
The function calls squads() and prints squad configuration.
The function calls watcher_status() and prints running status.

claims.text: Queue a local advisory review of the current diff.
claims.why: The function calls review_diff() with the provided lane and prints the queued result.

observations.what: All CLI entry points are thin delegations to core functions; no side effects or validation beyond argparse.
main_watcher only handles the 'status' subcommand; other subcommands silently fall through to help.
